title: Bivariate Numerical Correlation Analysis
description: Pairwise correlation assessment between continuous numerical features to discover linear and non-linear associations.
conditions: Two or more continuous numerical variables in tabular dataset
Screening for multicollinearity prior to regression or feature selection
recommended_methods: Pearson correlation coefficient (r) for linear Gaussian relationships
Spearman rank correlation (rho) for non-linear monotonic relationships
Kendall's Tau for small sample sizes or tied ranks
selection_rules: If variables violate normality or contain heavy outliers, report Spearman over Pearson
If absolute Pearson r > 0.85 between two predictor variables, flag for collinearity redundancy
If Spearman is high (> 0.7) but Pearson is moderate (< 0.4), relationship is monotonic non-linear
limitations: Zero correlation does not imply independence (e.g. quadratic relationships Y = X^2 have r = 0)
Correlation does not establish causal directionality
